rationale: No existing spec covers the RUM→distributed-trace correlation path (PlayerTracesTab in the session viewer, EventDetailDrawerContent 'View Trace', or the backend traces/time_range index). tracesSearch/traceDetails test the standalone Traces product only; rum-page-dataflow proves a session is listed/opened but never correlates to a backend trace. This feature is a distinct area (RUM trace time-range/indexed window) and needs its own spec under Traces/. Registration: append rumTraceTimeRange.spec.js to the 'Traces' shard run_files in ci_matrix.json.
